revised_prompt: Generate a detailed 16-bit pixel art key visual for an original retro desktop survival game. Wide landscape composition, approximately 16:9. Scene: a cramped Beijing rental room at dusk seen from inside. Carefully crafted crisp pixel art, deliberate pixel clusters, rich environmental storytelling, restrained dithering and old adventure-game atmosphere. A chunky beige CRT computer on a cluttered desk glows muted teal #176764, with an unbranded GPU retail box used as its monitor stand. On the desk are an instant noodle cup, scattered sticky notes with absolutely no writing, and a cute blue whale plush toy eating rice from a small bowl with chopsticks. The cramped room feels lived-in and modest, with believable desk clutter and cables. A window on the right shows the Beijing city skyline at orange sunset, a giant billboard depicting a tech launch event only through wordless imagery such as a product silhouette and stage lighting, and a tiny rocket in the sky. Composition is weighted toward the center-right; leave the left 40 percent calmer and darker, using muted dark teal and warm-grey room surfaces with sparse detail, suitable for later title overlay but with no title rendered. Warm muted palette: teal #176764, warm grey, navy #213d62, cream, and orange sunset. Gentle warm sunset light balances subdued CRT illumination. No purple neon, no cyberpunk glow. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or readable writing anywhere, including screen, notes, noodle cup, GPU box and billboard. Entire rectangular canvas fully filled edge-to-edge with opaque illustrated room and background; no transparency, no cutouts, no empty black corners, no black border, no vignette fading to black. Darker left area must still show softly readable opaque room colors and subtle room texture.
